eae88d0a.task:
Perform reconnaissance and attack-surface mapping against the single in-scope black-box target: https://cloudmate.onrender.com/

This is an authorized security validation scan. Do NOT test for vulnerabilities yet — only map and enumerate. Your job:

1. Technology fingerprinting: server headers, framework, language, JS libraries, versions (use httpx, whatweb-style probing via curl, wappalyzer-style hints).
2. Full content discovery: crawl the site with katana/gospider (bounded: depth 3, 5-10 min max), plus ffuf/dirsearch directory bruteforce against common wordlists (keep it time-boxed, ~5 min). Note: "cloudmate" suggests cloud cost/management tooling — look for dashboards, login pages, API endpoints, docs (swagger/openapi), admin paths.
3. Map ALL endpoints, parameters, forms, inputs — authenticated AND unauthenticated views. If there's a login/registration, register a test account if freely possible and crawl the authenticated surface; record how sessions work (cookies, JWTs, headers).
4. Analyze JS files: extract API routes, hidden endpoints, embedded keys/tokens, endpoints referenced in the frontend.
5. Record everything in shared notes via create_note: endpoint inventory, tech stack, auth model, roles/tenants visible, interesting parameters.
6. Record coverage entries via record_coverage for surfaces you mapped (recon-level, e.g. no_issue_found for "mapping only" is fine — or leave coverage for testing agents; at minimum note what you mapped).

Use the proxy tools (list_requests / view_request) for anything captured. Keep output bounded; clean up raw scan output files after extracting endpoint lists.

Report back via agent_finish with: tech stack, endpoint inventory (organized), auth/session model, parameter map, and anything anomalous worth deeper testing (endpoints that look juicy for IDOR/SSRF/injection, debug routes, etc.).
